content: Transactional outbox: write outbox row in same tx as domain mutation. Relay: poll (or LISTEN/NOTIFY-nudged) -> SELECT FOR UPDATE SKIP LOCKED batch -> publish -> mark delivered. Guarantee is at-least-once; consumers must dedup via stable message id. NATS JetStream: server-side dedup via Nats-Msg-Id header within bounded dedup window (~2min default); true exactly-once still needs idempotent consumers on top of at-least-once ('effectively-once').
